STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_151823.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_151823.v · Open raw
module origen_151823 (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input we,
    input ExcEnter,
    input [31:0] Din,
    input [4:0] CP0Index,
    input [4:0] ExcCode,
    input [7:0] HWInt,
    output [31:0] DOut,
    output [31:0] EPC,
    output [7:0] SR_IM,
    output SR_IE
);

    reg [31:0] SR;
    reg [31:0] Cause;
    reg [31:0] EPC_reg;
    reg [31:0] PRId;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            SR <= 32'h0000ffff;
            PRId <= 32'h00000000;
        end
        else begin
            if (we) begin
                case (CP0Index)
                    5'd12: SR <= Din;
                    5'd13: Cause <= Din;
                    5'd14: EPC_reg <= Din;
                    5'd15: PRId <= Din;
                    default: ;
                endcase
            end
            if (ExcEnter) begin
                Cause <= {27'b0, ExcCode, HWInt};
                SR <= {30'b0, 1'b0, 1'b0};
                EPC_reg <= Din;
            end
        end
    end

    assign DOut = (CP0Index == 5'd12) ? SR :
                  (CP0Index == 5'd13) ? Cause :
                  (CP0Index == 5'd14) ? EPC_reg :
                  (CP0Index == 5'd15) ? PRId : 32'b0;
    assign EPC = EPC_reg;
    assign SR_IM = SR[15:8];
    assign SR_IE = SR[0];

endmodule
